title: Apate sends AI agents undercover to get scammed so they can gather fraud intelligence

reason: TechCrunch reports Apate.ai's non-model AI product/agent launch for fraud intelligence, a business/product event covered by a reputable media outlet. Matches industry rule 3-1.
